name: reporter_cluster_heatmap_handbook
description: Heatmap reporter handbook: hm L1-L13 + cs L1-L13 + agg diversity. 26 primary layouts + 28 agg diversity testing temporal axes, Exact mode, styling, multi-value grid, sort, filters, and cs_heatmap temporal y_axis.
source:
# ========================================================================
# Heatmap Family Handbook — All Layouts (Simplified API)
# Assets: SPY, QQQ, DIA | Timeframe: 1D
# ========================================================================

# === Market Data ===
src = study_assets()
close = src.c
volume = src.v
daily_ret = (close - (close >> 1)) / (close >> 1)
vol_ratio = volume / sma(volume, 20)
daily_range_pct = (src.h - src.l) / close
gap_pct = (src.o - (close >> 1)) / (close >> 1)

# ========================================================================
# HEATMAP (per-asset) — L1 through L13
# Temporal axes auto-extract from DataFrame index; no datetime_extract needed
# ========================================================================

# L1: Monthly Returns Seasonality (the 80% case)
heatmap(
    x_axis=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    y_axis=CategoryAxisType.Year,
    value_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    data_label_format='{point.value:.1f}%',
    title='L1: Monthly Returns Seasonality',
    category='01 hm L1: Monthly Returns',
    x_axis_label='Month', y_axis_label='Year'
)(value=daily_ret)

# L2: DayOfWeek x Month
heatmap(
    x_axis=CategoryAxisType.DayOfWeek,
    y_axis=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    value_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    title='L2: Day-of-Week x Month Returns',
    category='02 hm L2: Weekday Effect'
)(value=daily_ret)

# L3: Quarterly Returns
heatmap(
    x_axis=CategoryAxisType.Quarter,
    y_axis=CategoryAxisType.Year,
    value_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    title='L3: Quarterly Returns',
    category='03 hm L3: Quarterly View'
)(value=daily_ret)

# L4: Volume Intensity
heatmap(
    x_axis=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    y_axis=CategoryAxisType.Year,
    title='L4: Volume Intensity',
    category='04 hm L4: Volume Intensity'
)(value=vol_ratio)

# L5: Range Volatility
heatmap(
    x_axis=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    y_axis=CategoryAxisType.Year,
    value_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    title='L5: Daily Range % Seasonality',
    category='05 hm L5: Range Volatility'
)(value=daily_range_pct)

# L6: DayOfWeek x Quarter
heatmap(
    x_axis=CategoryAxisType.DayOfWeek,
    y_axis=CategoryAxisType.Quarter,
    value_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    title='L6: Weekday x Quarter',
    category='06 hm L6: DayOfWeek x Quarter'
)(value=daily_ret)

# L7: Overnight Gap
heatmap(
    x_axis=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    y_axis=CategoryAxisType.Year,
    value_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    title='L7: Overnight Gap % by Month',
    category='07 hm L7: Overnight Gaps'
)(value=gap_pct)

# L8: Exact Axes (requires x, y inputs)
month_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month)(index())
year_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.year)(index())
heatmap(
    x_axis=CategoryAxisType.Exact,
    y_axis=CategoryAxisType.Exact,
    title='L8: Exact Axes Grid',
    category='08 hm L8: Exact Axes',
    x_axis_label='Month Number', y_axis_label='Year'
)(x=month_num, y=year_num, value=daily_ret)

# L9: Styling — no data labels, thick border
heatmap(
    x_axis=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    y_axis=CategoryAxisType.Year,
    show_data_labels=False,
    border_width=3,
    title='L9: Styling (No Labels + Borders)',
    category='09 hm L9: Styling'
)(value=daily_ret)

# L10: MonthYear on x-axis (compound type)
heatmap(
    x_axis=CategoryAxisType.MonthYear,
    y_axis=CategoryAxisType.DayOfWeek,
    value_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    title='L10: MonthYear x DayOfWeek',
    category='10 hm L10: MonthYear'
)(value=daily_ret)

# L11: QuarterYear on x-axis
heatmap(
    x_axis=CategoryAxisType.QuarterYear,
    y_axis=CategoryAxisType.DayOfWeek,
    value_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    title='L11: QuarterYear x DayOfWeek',
    category='11 hm L11: QuarterYear'
)(value=daily_ret)

# L12: Frequency / Win-Rate (agg=Mean on 0/1 indicator)
win_indicator = 1.0 if daily_ret > 0 else 0.0
heatmap(
    x_axis=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    y_axis=CategoryAxisType.Year,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    value_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    title='L12: Daily Win Rate by Month x Year',
    category='12 hm L12: Frequency (agg=Mean)'
)(value=win_indicator)

# L13: Observation Count (agg=Count)
obs_flag = where(is_valid(close), 1.0)
heatmap(
    x_axis=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    y_axis=CategoryAxisType.Year,
    agg=AggregationType.Count,
    title='L13: Trading Days per Month x Year',
    category='13 hm L13: Count (agg=Count)'
)(value=obs_flag)

# ========================================================================
# CS_HEATMAP (cross-sectional) — L1 through L13
# ========================================================================

# CS L1: Correlation Matrix
cs_heatmap(
    mode=HeatmapMode.correlation,
    title='CS L1: Return Correlation Matrix',
    category='14 cs L1: Correlation'
)(daily_ret)

# CS L2: Values Last
cs_heatmap(
    mode=HeatmapMode.values,
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    title='CS L2: Last Close Price',
    category='15 cs L2: Last Price'
)(close)

# CS L3: Values Mean
cs_heatmap(
    mode=HeatmapMode.values,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    value_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    title='CS L3: Mean Daily Return',
    category='16 cs L3: Mean Return'
)(daily_ret)

# CS L4: Values Std
cs_heatmap(
    mode=HeatmapMode.values,
    agg=AggregationType.Std,
    value_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    title='CS L4: Return Volatility',
    category='17 cs L4: Volatility'
)(daily_ret)

# CS L5: Values Min
cs_heatmap(
    mode=HeatmapMode.values,
    agg=AggregationType.Min,
    value_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    title='CS L5: Worst Daily Return',
    category='18 cs L5: Worst Day'
)(daily_ret)

# CS L6: Data labels off
cs_heatmap(
    mode=HeatmapMode.values,
    agg=AggregationType.Median,
    show_data_labels=False,
    title='CS L6: Median (No Labels)',
    category='19 cs L6: No Labels'
)(daily_ret)

# CS L7: Max Assets
cs_heatmap(
    mode=HeatmapMode.correlation,
    max_assets=2,
    title='CS L7: Correlation (Max 2)',
    category='20 cs L7: Max Assets'
)(daily_ret)

# CS L8: Multi-Value Grid
cs_heatmap(
    mode=HeatmapMode.values,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    series_names=['Avg Return', 'Avg Vol Ratio'],
    title='CS L8: Return + Volume Grid',
    category='21 cs L8: Multi-Value'
)(daily_ret, vol_ratio)

# CS L9: Sort by Value Descending
cs_heatmap(
    mode=HeatmapMode.values,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    sort_by_value=SortByValue.Descending,
    value_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    title='CS L9: Returns Sorted Desc',
    category='22 cs L9: Sort Desc'
)(daily_ret)

# CS L10: Sort Ascending + Max Assets
cs_heatmap(
    mode=HeatmapMode.values,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    sort_by_value=SortByValue.Ascending,
    max_assets=2,
    value_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    title='CS L10: Sort Asc + Max 2',
    category='23 cs L10: Sort + Max'
)(daily_ret)

# CS L11: Asset Filter
cs_heatmap(
    mode=HeatmapMode.values,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    filters=AssetFilterSchema(filters=[AssetFilter(rank=AssetFilterRank.Top, count=2, column=0)]),
    value_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    title='CS L11: Top 2 Assets',
    category='24 cs L11: Asset Filter'
)(daily_ret)

# CS L12: Temporal Values — Monthly seasonality across assets (NEW)
cs_heatmap(
    mode=HeatmapMode.values,
    y_axis=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    value_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    title='CS L12: Monthly Returns by Asset',
    category='25 cs L12: Temporal Month'
)(daily_ret)

# CS L13: Temporal Values — Quarterly
cs_heatmap(
    mode=HeatmapMode.values,
    y_axis=CategoryAxisType.Quarter,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    value_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    title='CS L13: Quarterly Returns by Asset',
    category='26 cs L13: Temporal Quarter'
)(daily_ret)

# ========================================================================

# ========================================================================

heatmap(
    agg=AggregationType.Sum,
    x_axis=CategoryAxisType.Month,
    y_axis=CategoryAxisType.Year,

heatmap(
